title: Roast cod with sprouting broccoli and sprouts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, sprouts, garlic, broccoli, cod, capers, lemon, olive oil and chilli flakes are all plain home ingredients with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Tesco stocks cod fillets, purple sprouting broccoli, sprouts, capers and the rest at everyday prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large roasting tray, a knife and a zester or grater, and the technique is simple staged roasting.

works.reason: The staged roasting at 220°C cooks the potatoes about 45 minutes, the sprouts about 25 and the cod and broccoli 12 to 15, which should work for four, although the tray will be full.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is fair for halving potatoes and sprouts, trimming broccoli and zesting a lemon, and 20+10+15 matches the 45 cook minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used, "sprouting broccoli" is the same food as its id, and the steps use nothing unlisted.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot roast traybake suits late January, and the purple sprouting broccoli is a main vegetable of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, potatoes and two green vegetables make a balanced, filling family dinner.
